section.content: The utility model relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a shell component, a positive pole column, a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece and electrolyte; the shell assembly comprises a shell and a cover plate, and the shell and the cover plate are in sealed welding connection; the shell is provided with a brim which is buckled on the cover plate, or the cover plate is provided with a brim which is buckled on the shell; the cover plate is provided with a connecting hole, the positive pole penetrates through the connecting hole and is arranged at an interval with the inner wall of the connecting hole, the first end of the positive pole is exposed out of the cover plate, and the second end of the positive pole extends into the shell; the positive plate is arranged in the shell and connected to the positive post; the negative plate is connected with the shell; electrolyte is injected into the shell. The shell and the cover plate are connected in a welding mode, so that the connection strength between the shell and the cover plate is high, the sealing performance of the welding sealing connection is high, and the electrolyte leakage phenomenon can be avoided. By arranging the positive pole column, the positive pole and the negative pole can be separated, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery can be ensured.

本实用新型涉及锂离子电池技术领域，公开了一种锂离子电池，包括壳体组件、正极柱、正极片、负极片及电解液；壳体组件包括壳体和盖板，壳体与盖板密封焊接连接；壳体上设置有帽檐，帽檐扣于盖板上，或盖板上设置有帽檐，帽檐扣于壳体上；盖板上设置有连接孔，正极柱穿设于连接孔，且与连接孔的内壁间隔设置，正极柱的第一端外露于盖板，第二端伸入于壳体内；正极片设置于壳体内，且连接于正极柱；负极片连接于壳体；壳体内注有电解液。壳体和盖板焊接连接，使二者之间的连接强度比较高，而且焊接密封连接的密封性比较高，可以避免电解液泄漏的现象。通过设置正极柱，可以保证正极与负极分割开来，保证锂离子电池可以正常使用。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery technical field especially relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

With the development of in-ear bluetooth headsets, button cells are applied more and more widely and are mostly used in electronic devices close to sensitive parts of the body. The existing button battery comprises a cover plate and a steel shell, and the steel shell is connected with the cover plate in a sealing mode through a sealing ring. If the sealing is in a problem, the risk of liquid leakage can occur, and the health of a human body can be endangered; and the connection strength is low.

Therefore, a lithium ion battery is needed to solve the above technical problems.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a lithium ion battery, casing and apron welded connection make the joint strength between the two than higher, and welded connection's leakproofness is than higher moreover, can avoid the phenomenon of electrolyte leakage.

To achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical proposal:

provided is a lithium ion battery including:

the shell assembly comprises a shell and a cover plate, and the shell is connected with the cover plate in a sealing and welding mode;

the shell is provided with a cap peak which is buckled on the cover plate, or the cover plate is provided with a cap peak which is buckled on the shell;

the cover plate is provided with a connecting hole, the positive pole penetrates through the connecting hole and is arranged at an interval with the inner wall of the connecting hole, the first end of the positive pole is exposed out of the cover plate, and the second end of the positive pole extends into the shell;

the positive plate is arranged in the shell and is connected to the positive pole;

a negative electrode tab connected to the case;

electrolyte, the casing is annotated with the electrolyte.

As a preferred scheme of lithium ion battery, still include first insulation piece, the first end of positive post outwards encircles and is equipped with the contact arch, the outside of apron is provided with the holding tank, the internal diameter of holding tank is greater than the bellied external diameter of contact, first insulation piece set up in the holding tank, the bellied bottom surface of contact support press in first insulation piece.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, the lithium ion battery further comprises a second insulating sheet, the positive plate is connected to the second end of the positive post, and the second insulating sheet is arranged between the positive plate and the cover plate.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, an explosion-proof wire is arranged on the shell.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, the cover plate is provided with an explosion-proof wire or an explosion-proof sheet.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, the cap peak is an arc-shaped groove.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, the cap peak is an L-shaped groove.

As a preferable scheme of the lithium ion battery, the cap peak is flat.

As a preferred scheme of the lithium ion battery, the shell and the cover plate are welded through laser or argon arc welding.

The utility model has the advantages that: the shell and the cover plate are connected in a welding mode, so that the connection strength between the shell and the cover plate is high, the sealing performance of the welding sealing connection is high, and the electrolyte leakage phenomenon can be avoided. By arranging the positive pole column, the positive pole and the negative pole can be separated, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery can be ensured.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention clearer, the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are some, but not all, embodiments of the present invention. The components of embodiments of the present invention, as generally described and illustrated in the figures herein, may be arranged and designed in a wide variety of different configurations.

Thus, the following detailed description of the embodiments of the present invention, presented in the accompanying drawings, is not intended to limit the scope of the invention, as claimed, but is merely representative of selected embodiments of the invention. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative efforts belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

It should be noted that: like reference numbers and letters refer to like items in the following figures, and thus, once an item is defined in one figure, it need not be further defined and explained in subsequent figures.

In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that the terms "upper", "lower", "left", "right", "vertical", "horizontal", "inner", "outer", etc. indicate the position or positional relationship based on the position or positional relationship shown in the drawings, or the position or positional relationship which is usually placed when the product of the present invention is used, and are only for convenience of description of the present invention and simplification of description, but do not indicate or imply that the device or element referred to must have a specific position, be constructed and operated in a specific orientation, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," "third," and the like are used solely to distinguish one from another and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance. In the description of the present invention, "a plurality" means two or more unless otherwise specified.

In the description of the present invention, it should also be noted that, unless otherwise explicitly specified or limited, the terms "disposed" and "connected" are to be interpreted broadly, and may be, for example, fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; either mechanically or electrically. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present invention can be understood in specific cases to those skilled in the art.

In the present disclosure, unless expressly stated or limited otherwise, the first feature "on" or "under" the second feature may comprise direct contact between the first and second features, or may comprise contact between the first and second features not directly. Also, the first feature being "on," "above" and "over" the second feature includes the first feature being directly on and obliquely above the second feature, or merely indicating that the first feature is at a higher level than the second feature. A first feature being "under," "below," and "beneath" a second feature includes the first feature being directly under and obliquely below the second feature, or simply meaning that the first feature is at a lesser elevation than the second feature.

Reference will now be made in detail to embodiments of the present invention, examples of which are illustrated in the accompanying drawings, wherein like reference numerals refer to the same or similar elements or elements having the same or similar function throughout. The embodiments described below with reference to the drawings are exemplary only for the purpose of explaining the present invention, and should not be construed as limiting the present invention.

As shown in fig. 1 to 3, the present embodiment discloses a lithium ion battery, which includes a housing assembly 1, a positive post 2, a positive plate 3, a negative plate, and an electrolyte.

The shell assembly 1 comprises a shell 11 and a cover plate 12, wherein the shell 11 and the cover plate 12 are connected in a sealing welding mode, particularly, the welding mode can be achieved through laser or argon arc welding, and when the welding mode is used, a circle of full welding needs to be conducted at the contact position of the shell 11 and the cover plate 12, so that the sealing performance between the shell 11 and the cover plate 12 is guaranteed. Preferably, in this embodiment, the housing 11 is provided with a visor 111, and the visor 111 is fastened to the cover plate 12 and then welded. The housing 11 and the cover plate 12 are made of steel. In other embodiments, the cover 12 is provided with a visor 111, and the visor 111 is fastened to the housing 11.

Optionally, the lithium ion battery further includes a first insulating sheet 4, the cover plate 12 is provided with a connection hole 121, the positive post 2 is inserted into the connection hole 121 and spaced apart from an inner wall of the connection hole 121, a first end of the positive post 2 is exposed out of the cover plate 12, and a second end of the positive post extends into the housing 11. The first end of positive post 2 is equipped with the contact arch 21 to the outer ring, and the outside of apron 12 is provided with holding tank 122, and connecting hole 121 is located the tank bottom of holding tank 122, and the internal diameter of holding tank 122 is greater than the external diameter of the contact arch 21, and the external diameter of first insulation piece 4 is the same with the internal diameter of holding tank 122, and first insulation piece 4 sets up in holding tank 122. Be provided with the first through-hole the same with positive post 2 external diameter on the first insulation piece 4, first through-hole is worn to locate by positive post 2, and the bottom surface of contact arch 21 is supported and is pressed in first insulation piece 4.

The shell 11 and the cover plate 12 are connected in a welding mode, so that the connection strength between the shell and the cover plate is high, the sealing performance of the welding sealing connection is high, and the electrolyte leakage phenomenon can be avoided. By arranging the positive pole column 2, the positive pole and the negative pole can be separated, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery can be ensured.

The lithium ion battery further comprises a second insulating sheet 5, and the positive plate 3 is arranged in the shell 11 and connected to the positive post 2. The positive plate 3 is welded at the second end of the positive post 2, and the second insulation sheet 5 is arranged between the positive plate 3 and the cover plate 12. The second insulating sheet 5 is provided with a second through hole with the same outer diameter as the positive post 2, and the positive post 2 penetrates through the second through hole. The shape of the second insulating sheet 5 is similar to that of the positive plate 3, and the surface area of the second insulating sheet is larger than that of the positive plate 3, so that the positive plate 3 can not be in contact with the cover plate 12, and the short circuit of the positive electrode and the negative electrode is avoided. The positive pole column 2 and the positive plate 3 are both made of aluminum, and the first insulating plate 4 and the second insulating plate 5 are made of rubber or silica gel.

The negative plate is arranged in the shell 11 and connected to the shell 11. In this embodiment, the negative electrode tab is directly welded to the case 11 and directly connected to the case 11. In other embodiments, the cover plate 12 may be welded to the housing 11 indirectly.

Electrolyte is injected into the shell 11, and the positive plate 3 and the negative plate are both soaked in the electrolyte.

Preferably, in this embodiment, an explosion-proof line (i.e., a score line) is disposed on the housing 11, and the thickness of the housing 11 at the explosion-proof line is relatively small, so that when the lithium ion battery fails and expands, the explosion-proof line is broken to discharge gas in the battery, thereby preventing the gas from accumulating to form high-pressure gas and exploding the battery. In other embodiments, a burst wire or burst disk is provided on the cover 12.

Preferably, in the present embodiment, the visor 111 is an L-shaped groove. In other embodiments, as shown in FIG. 4, the bill 111 is an arcuate groove. Alternatively, as shown in fig. 5, the visor 111 has a flat plate shape. Or as shown in fig. 6, the visor 111 is a flange outward from the top of the housing 11, and the cover 12 is in a cap shape and fastened to the housing 11.

It is obvious that the above embodiments of the present invention are only examples for clearly illustrating the present invention, and are not intended to limit the embodiments of the present invention. Other variations and modifications will be apparent to persons skilled in the art in light of the above description. And are neither required nor exhaustive of all embodiments. Any modification, equivalent replacement, and improvement made within the spirit and principle of the present invention should be included in the protection scope of the claims of the present invention.
